plugins.name: claude-code-slides
plugins.description: Create portable HTML, Marp, and PowerPoint presentations with seven visual themes and nineteen content-aware layouts.

interface.longDescription: Create story-driven HTML, Marp, and editable PowerPoint decks from briefs, documents, URLs, and repositories. Includes seven visual themes, nineteen semantic layout archetypes, deterministic validation, and layout-diversity rules.
defaultPrompt: Create a technical presentation from this repository using the default claude-editorial template and a varied layout sequence.
Turn this strategy brief into an executive PowerPoint using the executive-brief template.
Review this presentation and fix repetitive layouts and the highest-impact delivery issues.
